messages:
jamie (PM): Quick sync: Acme expects enterprise SSO for pilot. They mentioned SAML + user sync. This will affect MVP scope.
sara (eng): SAML auth is doable in a short cycle; SCIM/user sync hits provisioning and will take longer.
devin (infra): Constraint: if pilot is on Dedicated we can avoid private network work for now. But Dedicated implies reserved capacity.
jamie (PM): Proposal: include SAML auth in MVP, defer SCIM to v1. Pilot runs on Dedicated. Any blockers?
raj (sales): I can get them to agree to a pilot with SAML auth only if we commit publicly to SCIM in v1 timeline. Otherwise they might pause.
maria (design): I can ship a minimal SSO setup flow and a notice about Dedicated-only pilots.
sara (eng): Estimate: 2 engineers x ~2.5 weeks to get SAML auth + e2e. SCIM initial push is another ~3 weeks after.
jamie (PM): Cuts: move embeddings cache and tenant-routing full rollout to v1 to free up eng cycles. Agree?
devin (infra): Agree. I'll add a console guardrail toggle to force Dedicated for pilot tenants (3d).
rollout-bot: dedicated-pool-check: available_nodes=2 in us-west, no immediate capacity issues.
jamie (PM): OK. New MVP feature-freeze: 2026-05-18. If SAML slips, fallback = OIDC-only pilot. I'll update roadmap and open tickets.
